captions.detailed: An Eastern Orthodox bell tower consisting of a tall, light-grey cylindrical masonry shaft, a colonnaded open belfry with four pillars, and a green onion dome topped by a golden cross spire. A dark bronze bell is suspended inside the belfry from a horizontal wooden beam. The bell is mounted on a revolute joint, allowing it to swing back and forth around the horizontal axis of its support beam.
captions.instruction: Generate an Eastern Orthodox onion-dome bell tower with a cylindrical white masonry shaft, an open belfry, a green onion dome, and a golden spire cross. Inside the belfry, hang a dark bronze bell on a horizontal headstock beam using a revolute joint so that the bell can swing.
captions.factory: Construct the tower base, shaft, and belfry deck using stacked cylinders, subtracting material to form an open colonnade with vertical pillars. Create the green onion dome by lofting or revolving a curved profile, and place a gold-colored cross spire on top. Build the bell assembly from a horizontal cylinder for the headstock and a revolved bell-shaped profile, then mount the bell to the headstock using a revolute joint aligned along the horizontal Y-axis.
